# Kaleidoscope

> Local native memory for agents, exposed through a manager CLI and persistent stdio MCP. Release status: staging (unreleased); no package or production login is public.

- [Documentation](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/): product and developer overview
- [Getting started](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/getting-started/): protected RC install, profile and reversible host workflow
- [Packages](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/packages/): full SDK facades, native companions, exact macOS arm64 RC hashes and gates
- [CLI reference](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/cli/): exact local manager-candidate commands
- [MCP reference](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/mcp/): candidate-bound `search` and `remember` contract
- [Integrations](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/integrations/): Codex, Claude, Cursor, OpenCode, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI, and generic MCP
- [Security](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/security/): package, process, and account isolation evidence
- [Privacy](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/privacy/): local/account data boundary, credential storage, and telemetry status
- [Account](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/account/): login manages account/device state and does not upload local memory
- [Operations](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/operations/): backup, restore, uninstall, update, and exact vault deletion
- [Compatibility](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/compatibility/): verified local cells versus native/support holds
- [Benchmarks](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/benchmarks/): merged candidate-bound smoke, with no score or release claim
- [Release evidence](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/docs/evidence/): exact digests, converged package proof, milestone commits, and protected gates
- [Public agent skill](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/SKILL.md): bounded retrieval and verified durable writes
- [Agent instructions](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/agent-instructions.md): safe manager-installed AGENTS, CLAUDE, and Cursor pointers
- [Machine-readable staging evidence](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/staging-evidence.json): source-free milestone and gate record
- [Candidate CLI help](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/reference/kaleidoscope-cli.candidate.txt): exact consolidated manager help snapshot
- [Candidate MCP reference](https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/reference/kaleidoscope-mcp.candidate.json): exact engine and public-contract binding plus tool fields

The `0.1.0-rc.1` package contract is verified only for macOS arm64. SDK commit fc15e1ec7d98a9d37983cea87ab23bfc0b7fd317 puts the full public TypeScript/Python clients, installed-payload resolvers and both `kaleidoscope`/`kscope` launchers in the facade packages. Assembler commit af892d180fe01729450e03917f33ac56698e90e1 pairs them with native companions containing manager object code and the proprietary object code engine; final evidence commit d9409ebacf63bcf2b32fde56a31a6350cfdfd491 freezes the result. Exact hashes: release archive fc37a2caa00f038bf7c260e53b62c9bee6d5e78df1cc3568a180816a3d9b2abf; manifest 39c8738cd938e79b10a20d429ace1fb6a4eda73b1f25a99681a8104dd2e0ef2f; build proof eb23e9f490179e6d84f4933de5ea5b2ff390030798727ba1ddd90628106b4d94; package proof 095f91ca73faf811a888771dc1298a200193458df63ae5cb890a16f632bc1d3c; npm facade c30d45d9ccc61b36ede7b6df87f6728aa9307445a08446a7de5de5bafe9c0605; npm native companion a2cd8924c89a74204fcb9ee8790daf6a53d4ce4bec6fdf6329e127ff9b5b5d12; Python facade 7208468413a44412959e0426cf7fb508ca7f32861fcd0ee79ec0f6bedb88e68c; Python native companion 24eb29ac7ec70a2a9d36832994d5a17cba2b42f6a12fd6557f541bd2890f89d3; SBOM a236f913fa83bf02e99605ba573203ba7cb48f7798ad8728c2aa4d590fd191f3; provenance a177d3537d87bfba08e77fe4171e41dff69a757499a742c8a5501ed5777b1d56; test-only signature envelope 7fc485f638bcf3327804009bf2890afb96b106fd3171e6f8a013dadac90510d2. The engine source is not in any public surface. Manager SHA-256 fc6afb3606fcd312a7a7188e6f9ec2e72c6885f3f4a87e11b5eeb9b291bf336b; engine SHA-256 988192ac9677d5dd55a3642b2da493a0806bb860b5b3c0f509b37ddadee08825; public contract SHA-256 a2357ed6c00e3e143d08581590571447e31d24fd0e7d2466d28a211a0515c75e; final package evidence SHA-256 f23c4a0fea5aa260ec41f10f2da23c3bab5147a942aa3e3ea09a3d7473918be0; DX-09 fixture evidence SHA-256 f2d2a43bd8ee137f980c83398ec7197e26eedd2395d019926e38ea7531a2a504; historic DX-10A evidence SHA-256 cfb0c09eccc2dffeca67fb324927b602f6f1158a9d6e85682cc3112fd696b12e; historic pre-final Codex-host evidence SHA-256 74ab8ac26bbb0a3d6093c8d4db467de8d998882801a815495ada0ad0fc1ec840. Final package evidence proves fresh npm/Python facade init, doctor, Codex dry-run configuration, and MCP discovery—not real host/IDE acceptance. All packages remain private, test-signed, unpublished and outside a support claim. Hosted memory is planned, not available. Production licensing/EULA, signing, registry publication, login and Pages promotion require separate approval.
